title: Moroccan Amlou Stuffed Sweet Potato
description: A flavorful and nutritious vegan dish, perfect for a warm evening. Sweet potatoes are stuffed with a delicious mixture of amlou, exotic spices, and crunchy snacks.
instructions: Wash and poke the sweet potatoes with a fork to allow steam to escape.
Rub the sweet potatoes with olive oil and place them on a baking sheet.
Bake for 45-60 minutes, or until tender.
While the sweet potatoes are baking, mix together amlou, exotic spices, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
When the sweet potatoes are done, let them cool for a few minutes.
Slice them in half lengthwise and scoop out some of the flesh to make room for the filling.
Fill the sweet potatoes with the amlou mixture, snappy peas, and a drizzle of date syrup (if using).
Serve warm, garnished with lemon juice and a sprinkle of exotic spices.
Optional: top with toasted nuts or seeds for added crunch.
